msgid: You know, everything tastes great\nwhen you're out in the wild.
Yay, yay!\nPOKéMON!
There appear to be many secrets\nstill unsolved in this world.
I'm pretty familiar with the land\naround these parts.
I sensed your approach.
Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.
It doesn't matter if you happen to\nhave the strongest POKéMON…\pIt doesn't mean a thing if you don't\nknow how to use them properly!
I work to protect the environment.\nIn turn, nature protects me!
A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep\ninside here.
LOSTELLE: Hi, {PLAYER}!\nYou're always so cool!\pI'll make lunch for you, too, one\nday, {PLAYER}.
Rare rocks and gems are displayed.
There's nothing that young people'd\nfind exciting here on this island.\pBut, this is a good place in terms\nof nature and history.\pRelax and enjoy your stay.
I let a pleasant breeze lead me\nall the way here.
Giggle… You're so cute when you're\ndetermined.
I want to go to the woods over\nthere, but…\pThere are lots of BUG POKéMON.\nThey scare me a little.
I'm practicing in secret so no one\ncan see me.
Nobody saw me losing, right?
As a performer, I don't want people\nto know about the effort I put in.
What, you're suggesting that you're\nsick of seeing SWIMMERS like me?\pAww, don't be hatin'!
I couldn't lift the stigma of being\na SWIMMER…
My boyfriend's always busy, so I\ncome swimming by myself.
Awww, I knew this would happen!
When I can't be with my boyfriend,\nI spend time with the POKéMON he\lgave me.
Tell me, where are the mountains\naround these parts?
I lost my way while I was busy\nbattling!
Aren't there any mountains around\nthese parts?
MIU: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to play!
MIU: Oh, no!\nMommy!
MIU: It makes me all sad inside\nwhen we lose…
MIU: MIA and I are TWINS.\nWe want to battle together.
MIA: Hello, POKéMON!\nIt's time to battle!
MIA: You're mean!\nYou're bad for winning!
MIA: Ohh…\nI'm sorry, my POKéMON…
MIA: Oh, you only have one\nPOKéMON?\pDon't you feel lonesome?
Wanted!\nThe Ultimate Horn!
WATER PATH\nLeads to RUIN VALLEY
W-what do you intend to do with\nme?
Oh… I was afraid that you meant to\nharm me.

I am so glad that you happened
here.\pI grew rather bored of walking,
and I am feeling fatigued.\pMay I ask you to take me home
from here?
There are many POKéMON locked\naway in the pen…
The pen door is unlocked.\nThe POKéMON appear to have fled.
Did you come here knowing it's\nTEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE?
TEAM ROCKET broke up?\nWhat planet are you from?
Oh, now your POKéMON look strong.\nYou're willing to sell them?\pOh?\nYou wanted to battle?
Oh, but…\nToo much!
We can give you a great price.\nSell us your POKéMON!
I got word about you from the\nothers.\pBut there's no way a kid like you'd\nknow our BOSS GIOVANNI!
Don't…you…dare…laugh…
Don't mess in the doings of adults,\nyou jumped-up pip-squeak!
I don't know or care if what I'm\ndoing is right or wrong…\pI just put my faith in GIOVANNI\nand do as I am told.
I…\nI'm shattered…
You're doing things according to\nyour beliefs and morals.\pI understand now…

I've made it so you can come back
in through there.\pWhy don't you go get rested and
refreshed for what lies ahead?\pThe ADMIN after me outranks me
thoroughly as a TRAINER.\pYou'd better steel yourself for one
harsh challenge.

That's quite enough of you 
playing the hero, kid.\pSpreading lies about how TEAM
ROCKET has disbanded…\pIt's such an obvious attempt to
cause confusion in our ranks.\pFortunately, we're not so ignorant
to fall for the lies of a child!\pAnd now, I'll show you how scary
an angry adult can be!

Urgh…
You were too strong…\p…
Th-that's GIOVANNI's BADGE!\pSo it's true?
TEAM ROCKET really has disbanded?
We will abandon this WAREHOUSE…\pBut don't think this is over.\nI won't let this be the end.\pI will find GIOVANNI.\nAnd I will resurrect TEAM ROCKET!\lI will…\pUntil then, farewell!
A report with graphs and text is on\nthe PC monitor.\p“The Influence of Magnetic Waves\non POKéMON Evolution”…\p… … … … … …\pIt's too difficult to understand…

I almost managed to sell the
SAPPHIRE for huge money…\pThen, you just had to come along
and blow the whole deal apart!\pFufu… Fufufufu…
There's no forgiveness for you!
Gah! Darn!\nDarn! Darn!
If I can't sell it, it's worthless!\nGo ahead, take it!
What do you want now?\nGo on, get lost, leave me be.

What, you again?\pYou… You're not GIOVANNI's kid,
are you?\pNo, that can't be right!
GIOVANNI's kid has red hair.\pYou don't have any reasons for
bugging me. Leave me alone!
…Huh?\pI was envisioning my house, but\nthis is where I TELEPORT?
Big boo-boo!
I am so scatterbrained!\pI need to focus so I can TELEPORT\nproperly to my house!
GREEN PATH\nPATTERN BUSH AHEAD
GREEN PATH\nThink Green, Keep Nature Clean!

I'm the POKéMON MOVE MANIAC.\pI know every single move that
POKéMON learn growing up.\pI'm also a mushroom maniac.\pBring me two TINYMUSHROOMS,
or one BIG MUSHROOM.\pIf you do that for me, I'll teach
a move to one POKéMON.
Sniff, sniff…\nHm! You smell of MUSHROOMS!\pDo you want me to teach a move\nto a POKéMON of yours?
Sorry…\pIt doesn't appear as if I have a\nmove I can teach that POKéMON.
Then, I'll need a MUSHROOM or two.\nWhat are you going to give me?
{PLAYER} handed over two\nTINYMUSHROOMS in exchange.
{PLAYER} handed over one\nBIG MUSHROOM in exchange.
If your POKéMON need to learn a\nmove, I need a MUSHROOM or two.
Hunh? There isn't a single move\nthat I can teach an EGG.
Not many people come out here.\pIf I train here, I'm convinced that\nI'll get stronger and stronger.\pYep, stronger and stronger…\pHow would you like to learn a move\nlike that? It's SWORDS DANCE.
Well, that's fine, too.
All right, pick which POKéMON\nI should teach it to.
If only we could keep getting\nstronger and stronger, eh?
SEVEN ISLAND\nQuest Island of Infinity

These islands are called the SEVII
ISLANDS because there are seven.\p…Or at least that's what the young
people believe.\pThe truth is, these islands are so
named because they are said to\lhave been made in seven days.
This island has been left virtually\nuntouched in its natural state.\pIt could be a little difficult to\nhike around because of that.
A mysterious rumble echoed\nsomewhere far away.
Give up…
In your future, I sense that you\nwill meet many others.\pI think you will be linked to each\nother by a strange power.
What an amazing TRAINER!
Somewhere on this island, peculiar\nPOKéMON are sleeping.\pCould it be that they're waiting\nfor you?
TRAINER TOWER ENTRANCE\nRise to the Challenge, TRAINERS!
TRAINER TOWER AHEAD

Hm!
Haaaaaaaaaaah!\pAaaah! This is heavenly!
The water warms me to my core!\pYou should jump in, too.\pGo to the middle, relax, and get
good and warm!
My favorite part of bathing comes\nup right after this.\pI enjoy a bowl of chowder to\nwarm me from the inside, too!
The water is perfectly warm.\nIt feels exquisite…\p{PLAYER} and the POKéMON were\nfully refreshed!
Soaking in a hot spring pool is\ntherapeutic, people say.
Have a look at my face.\nSee how smooth my skin is?\pThe hot spring's water keeps my\nskin younger than my age.

After an honest day of training,
nothing beats a relaxing soak in\lthe hot spring pool.\pBRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,
visits the SPA on occasion.\pHe comes to rehab injuries, both
his own and his POKéMON's.

Hot springs go hand-in-hand with
volcanoes.\pThe EMBER SPA here, well,
I made it years ago.\pI hewed the pool right out of a
gigantic boulder by hand.\pI was using this at the time.
I suppose I can part with it.
That shatters boulders as if they\nwere made of crackers.
Kyahaha!\nI'll flick you away effortlessly!
Tch!\nToo strong for me!
What's that?\nI don't act the way I look?\pHeh, that's a part of my strategy!
Howdy!\nAre you a member of my fan club?
Oh, so you're not a fan…\pWell, I can change that.\nLet me sing for you!
Lalalah…\nMy POKéMON, I send them out,\lall the girls scream and shout!
This island is too spread out…\nIt's not easy patrolling the place.
Uh-huh…
TRAINERS like you from cities,\nthey sure are tough.\pYou'll be headed for the TOWER,\nwon't you?
I punish people who abuse\nPOKéMON!
You don't seem to be a problem\nTRAINER.
If you treat your POKéMON with\nkindness, they'll understand.
EVE: I'll team up with JON and\nbattle together.
EVE: Me and JON, we lost.\nEhehe.
EVE: I'm going to work harder with\nJON.
EVE: I want to team up with JON\nwhen I battle you.\pCome back with two POKéMON, okay?
JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels\nlike we could never lose.
JON: When I'm with EVE,\nit doesn't feel like I've lost!
JON: When I'm with EVE, I feel\ngiddy whether I win or lose.\pIt's magical!
JON: If it's with EVE, I'll be\nhappy to battle with you.\pSo, I'd like to make it a\ntwo-on-two battle, if I may.
SEVAULT CANYON ENTRANCE\pTRAINERS are asked to refrain from\ndamaging plants in the CANYON.

We've had a great and powerful
TRAINER grow up on this island.\pI bet even you'd know her.
It's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!\pWhen LORELEI was just a tyke,
I taught her about POKéMON.

The SEVII ISLANDS are in a warm
region overall.\pBut there is one exception you
need to know about.\pThe ICEFALL CAVE is frigid because
of the POKéMON that live in it.

Ready?
Boing!\pWe're having a BODY SLAM match
to see who wimps out first.\pIf you were to join us, you'd be
squashed like a bug, though…\pHow about I teach BODY SLAM to
a POKéMON of yours instead?
Come again!\nBoing!
Which POKéMON wants to learn how\nto BODY SLAM?
Boioing!
There's a rare kind of ICE POKéMON\nthat lives in the cave.\pWe get a lot of visitors hoping to\nsee that POKéMON.

Oh? A POKéMON EGG?
…I have no idea.\p…Oh, wait. The DAY-CARE people
in town were saying something.\pThey said that they'd found EGGS
before on their property.
What's this?\pThe new POKéMON JOURNAL hasn't\narrived on this island?
Young people all want to go off to\nbig cities.\pBut I want to stay here forever!
Now, where's LOSTELLE gotten to\ntoday?\pShe always brings me lunch every\nday right about now…

Hm? You, there!
Are you a friend of LOSTELLE's?\pHave you seen LOSTELLE around?
I don't know where she might be.\lShe should've been here long ago.\pLOSTELLE's a cutie - she got my
looks - so what if someone…\pWhat if something's happened to
my LOSTELLE?!\pPlease, help me find her!
Please go search THREE ISLAND!

Hah? What is this GAME CORNER?
How much sadder can this get?\pThose clowns…\pThey said they'd be waiting on the
island, so where are they?\pHey, you! Is this the only THREE
ISLAND around here?
Try waking up before you crawl out\nof bed, you punk.\pThis is TWO ISLAND!\pMove it! Get your filthy motorbike\nout of my place!
Huh…\nOh, oh, gotcha.\pTch…\nThese islands are confusing…
Would you look at that?\nThat punk scuffed up my floor.

Hey, but listen! I'm begging you,
you have to go to THREE ISLAND.\pIf anything were to happen to my
LOSTELLE…\pMy place is the house with the red
roof on THREE ISLAND.\pShe may just show up late here,
so I can't run off anywhere.\pThat's why I have to get you to do
me this big favor.
I'm sorry.\nWe're not running any games today.
We'll get the games going soon\nfor you!
So you rescued LOSTELLE?\nHow can I thank you?\pLOSTELLE, darling, forgive me!\pDaddy didn't know you were scared\nand in trouble!
LOSTELLE: It's okay, Daddy.\nI got to be friends with {PLAYER}!

Oh, what's that?
You're saying that this is for me?\pHow did you know that I love rare
rocks and gems?\pYou sure know how to make a guy
happy.
{PLAYER} handed the METEORITE\nto LOSTELLE's daddy.
Oh, I see, this is from BILL!\nYou have to thank him for me!\pYou know, you've been fantastic.\nI want you to have this.
{PLAYER} received a MOON STONE\nfrom LOSTELLE's daddy.
Your BAG's not going to fit another\nthing…
All right, I'll get the GAME CORNER\nrunning right away.\pYou have to come visit with a\nfriend.
Listen, listen!\pPlease show me you being cool\nagain!
I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the beak.
Oh, so sharp!
You can fly to FOUR ISLAND from\nhere.
I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the wings.
There was a really somber guy\nover that way.
I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the down.
Down is so comfy…\nIt makes me drowsy…
It fills me with happiness when\nbird POKéMON beg playfully…
Scrub, scrub…
Hello…\nYour POKéMON look healthy…
This is where I buried my ONIX…\nIt was named TECTONIX…
“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.\pThere is a LEMONADE placed as an\noffering in front of the grave.
Would you like to leave another\nLEMONADE as an offering?
{PLAYER} placed a can of LEMONADE\nin front of the grave.

Th-thank you…\pThat was my TECTONIX's favorite
drink…\pI don't even know you, but your
act of kindness…\pIt's uplifted me a little.\pCan you please take this as my
thanks?
Please be good to your POKéMON,\ntoo.
If you don't have room for it,\nI'll hold it for you till next time.
Oh, it's you from that time…\pI still have that thing I wanted\nyou to have as my thanks.
Scrub, scrub…\p… … …\nTECTONIX…
Boulders and rocks are neatly piled\nup as a cairn.\p“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.
Aiyeeeeeh!\pI thought this was an ancient ruin.\nBut it's teeming with ghosts!
Aiyeeeeeh!\nMercy!
I'm trying to get out of here, but\nI always end up at the same spot.\pMaybe the number of boulders is\na hint…
You must never, ever go out to\nthe BERRY FOREST alone.\pWhy?\nThere are ghosts there.
Papa keeps lying to me, and won't\nlet me go out and play!
There! Boing!\nYou're awfully heavy!
I'm curious, how do you raise your\nPOKéMON?
You raise your POKéMON with a\nwhole lot of love!
In the same way your mother raised\nyou full of love, you should raise\lyour POKéMON.
I'm working to preserve the natural\necology of POKéMON here.
Oh, for someone so young, you are\ntremendous!
I'm not saying that you shouldn't\ncatch POKéMON.\pI just want people to raise their\nPOKéMON responsibly.
I caught a BUG POKéMON that lives\nonly around here!
Heheh…\nIsn't my POKéMON awesome?
There's a girl near the BUSH who\nmeasures HERACROSS for TRAINERS.
You know, it just doesn't feel right\nif I don't use BUG POKéMON.
It's okay, losing is a fun part of\nPOKéMON's appeal, too.
By the way, “appeal” is a weird\nword, if you think about it.\pLike, is it like an orange peel?\nOr like a ringing bell?
Yeah, yeah, yeah!\nLook at all the BUG POKéMON!
I got beat while I was still busy\ncelebrating!
I'm going to bring my little brother\nhere next time.
Look, look! There are funny\npatterns on the ground.
The funny patterns on the ground…\pThey look like the patterns on my\ngrandpa's clothes.
I bet you think I'm just some guy,\ndon't you, eh?
I bet you think I'm weak,\ndon't you, eh?
Ayup, you townies come around all\nso dandy with a hat that flashy…\pHow about giving me that?
Take a deep breath.\nIsn't the air delicious?
If you'd like, I can teach you how\nto breathe properly.
First, exhale.\nBlow everything out.\pWhen you can't exhale anymore,\ninhale the clean air!\pIsn't it refreshing?
I love BUG POKéMON.\nThat's why I'm here all the time.\pAm I the only girl like that?
I lost, but I'm still laughing.\nAm I the only girl like that?
I'm going to keep on collecting\nBUG POKéMON.\pAm I the only girl like that?
This is a good spot.\nI'll pitch my tent here.
Wimped out…
I'm going to observe the night sky\nhere.
Oh, yuck!\nI think a bug stung me!
It wasn't a bug.\nI cut my shin on some grass.
A little cut like that…\nA little spit's enough to cure it!
Have you noticed something odd\nabout these parts?
Have you taken a good look around\nyour feet?
There are places here in PATTERN\nBUSH where grass won't grow.\pWhat could be the cause of such\na phenomenon?
With these hands, I will create\nmy victory!
The shame of this…\nI'm red-faced…
Uh-oh, my paint tubes have\nscattered everywhere!
Excuse me!\nI'm trying to paint.\lPlease keep out of my sight!
This loss…\nI feel like I'm whiting out…
GILLIAN?\nPlease tilt your head slightly…\lThere! That's the look I want!
Hmm…\nThe angle, it is not quite there…
Oh…\nMy feelings, they are blue…
The sky and the sea…\nThey are so fickle.\pTheir changing expressions make\nthem difficult to capture.
I am visiting my friend's retreat,\nif you must know.
Oh, my, so strong.
I find it pleasurable to leisurely\nbattle in the gentle sea breeze.
I'm thinking of having a pool\nmade specially for POKéMON.
Oh, my goodness gracious!
A pool would be nice, but I must\nsay, a sun-room may be sublime.
I'm a good runner.\nI'm really fast!
Oops!\nI rushed things!
When I run with the wind, it feels\nlike I could fly!
I say, this marine life here at\nthis resort agrees with me.
That's a shocker!\nYou must be joking.
Getting so serious over this…\nHow nonsensical.
SELPHY: Thank you.\pYou may go now.
SELPHY'S HOUSE
We're the KANTO RIDER FEDERATION!\nVroom! Vavavavooom! Vroom!\pMy bike's wimpy, so I have to\nmake exhaust noises myself!
Hey, hey, lady!\nFork over some spending money!
Aiyeeh!\pWh-who are you?!\nI… I'll call the police!
Those BIKERS…\nAre they gone?\pOh, thank goodness!\nThey certainly had me terrified!
Those BIKERS ran off, and\nLOSTELLE was found safe.\pEverything turned out for the best!
SELPHY: Oh?\nDo I know you from somewhere?\pOh, but that doesn't matter.\pI am exquisitely bored.\nPlease, hear my wish.
I wish to see a POKéMON.\nA darling {STR_VAR_1}.\pI want to see one right away.\nPlease, make my wish come true.
SELPHY: Oh, I'm tired of this.\nI'm tired of waiting for you.\pI'll forgive you this time, but\nplease don't fail me next time.

SELPHY: Oh, hello, there.\pOh, my gracious. That must be the
{STR_VAR_1} you caught for me.\pGiggle…
I see a resemblance to you.\pThank you so kindly.\p… …  … …  … …
Is something the matter?\pYou may leave.\p… …  … …  … …
Oh, fine. I understand now.\pSEBASTIAN!
I need you here this instant!
Butler: Yes, my lady.
SELPHY: See to it that this person\nis given a token of appreciation.
Butler: I shall do as you bid,\nmy lady.
Butler: I sincerely thank you for\npleasing Lady SELPHY.\pPlease accept this as her thanks…
Butler: Your BAG appears to be\nunfortunately full.
SELPHY: I wish you the best of\nluck.
Butler: The smile of Lady SELPHY\nhas the brilliance of the sun.\pPlease, I beg you to bring joy\nto Lady SELPHY.
{PLAYER} found a SAPPHIRE!
Fufu… Fufufufu…\nI guessed right.\pI was right in tailing you!

I knew that there was a SAPPHIRE
here, so it belongs to me!\pI'll sell it to TEAM ROCKET for
serious money.\p…D-don't glare at me like that!\pIf you want it back, why don't you
go get it after I sell it?\pI'll even tell you one of the
passwords to TEAM ROCKET's\lWAREHOUSE.\pThe WAREHOUSE password I know is
“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\pI'm done.
Don't think badly of me!
Lying back, rocked by the waves…\nIt's exquisite.
I lost…\nIt feels awful.
The sea is pleasantly warm in these\nparts.
Good things get washed up by the\nocean current onto this beach.\pThat's why I often come here for\nsome beachcombing.
Hey, did you hear the news?\pThe PC network here can now link\nwith PCs in KANTO.\pI don't know how that came about,\nbut it's fantastic!
It's impossible to SURF between the\nislands around these parts.\pThe tides are too fast and\ntreacherous.
Let's crush BERRIES!\n…That'd be wasting BERRIES?\pYou can always find some BERRIES\non the ground in BERRY FOREST.

Can you imagine?
If this volcano were to erupt?\pThe explosion would be the end of
us. How terrifying is that?\pWhile we're terrified, would you
like me to teach EXPLOSION?
Yeah, you're right.\nIt is too terrifying.
You're terribly brave!\pWhich POKéMON should I teach\nEXPLOSION?
Using EXPLOSION while on this\nvolcano…\pWhat a terrifying thrill!
Over here.\nWe'll try digging here.\pThat treasure the ADMINS've been\ntalking about should be here.
What the…?\nYou're in the way. Get lost.
Whew, punched through at last.\nLet's go treasure hunting!
Any treasure we find, we haul back\nto the WAREHOUSE, understood?\p…Oh, and what're the passwords?\nAt the ROCKET WAREHOUSE, I mean.
What, you forgot the password?\nThere're actually two.\pThe first one's “GOLDEEN need\nlog.”\pAnd the second one is…
Hey!\nThis snoop's been listening in!
You've been eavesdropping on us,\nhaven't you?
Huh, what?
Why'd you have to win?
Trying to horn in on our treasure?\nDon't bet on it!
Wait!\nBut how?
Develop amnesia conveniently and\nforget everything you heard!

What a setback…
We'll have to regroup.\pYou! Don't even think about taking
a step inside here!\pIf you know what's good for you,
don't even think about this!
An active volcano is one that's\nerupting, or about to.
Whew… That was hot!\nSweat's erupting from me!
They say there're over 1,500\nactive volcanoes in the world.\pJust thinking about them makes me\nfeel all hot and gooey inside!
Do you know how caves form inside\nvolcanoes?
Atchah!\nYou're shockingly good!
When lava at the surface of magma\nhardens, and the magma inside flows\lout, caverns are left behind.
I've been in training so I can mend\nmy broken heart…\pIt toughened me up physically at\nleast! Hi-yah!
I think I tried to overdo it…
The way you battle, it reminds me\nof the guy who dumped me…
Dance, dance!\nCHANSEY Dance!\pYou join in, too!\nDance, dance!
Would you like to dance?
Come on, dance!
{PLAYER} danced the CHANSEY Dance!
Ahahahaha!\pThere, you're all chipper now!\nLucky!
CHANSEY: Chansi! Chansi!
I think there is a mysterious power\nat work in this cave.
If you don't go into the right\ntunnel, you won't get ahead.
Earlier, a lady went into the caves\nahead.
{PLAYER} entered a password.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\p… …  … …  … …\pAnother password is needed to\nopen the door…
{PLAYER} entered two passwords.\p“GOLDEEN need log.”\n“Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”\p… …  … …  … …\pThe WAREHOUSE's door opened!
The WAREHOUSE's door is already\nopen.
This area's strictly off-limits!\nOut, out!
Is this for real?
You don't have any business here!\nGo home!
There's nothing past here except\nour WAREHOUSE.\pSo what brings you here?
That wasn't supposed to happen…
You're wanting to know what's inside\nthis WAREHOUSE?\pIt's better you didn't know.\nFor your own sake, I mean.
You'd be wasting time even if you\nwere to get by me.
Oh, that makes me furious!
You won't be able to get in without\nthe passwords anyway.

LOSTELLE: Whimper… Sniff…
Oh! Please, help!\pA scary POKéMON appeared there
a little while ago.\pIt kept scaring.
It made LOSTELLE scared.\pI'm too scared to move!
But I want to go home…
Oh! Here it comes again!\nNo! Go away! It's scaring me!\pWaaaaaaah!\nI want my daddy!
Ohh! That was so scary!\nThank you!\pLOSTELLE came to pick some\nBERRIES.\pYou can have this!
What's your name?\pLOSTELLE's scared, so can I go\nwith you to my daddy's house?\pOkay!\nLet's go home!
Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nI guess you don't want this.
Welcome to the BERRY FOREST\pBe friendly and share BERRIES with\nothers and POKéMON.
Beware of wild, BERRY-loving\nPOKéMON!
Do you know anything about this\nstone chamber?
That was uncalled for.\nYou didn't have to be so rough.
The TANOBY RUINS date back at\nleast 1,500 years.\pBut it's a baffling mystery as to\nwhy it was built in the first place.
I'm not much good in battle.
I hear there are other ruins like\nthe one here.\pMight they be the resting places\nof other mystic POKéMON?
CLIFFORD is teaching me how to\npaint.
We might get in trouble for being\nnoisy here.
I said that I wanted to paint an\nold building.\pSo CLIFFORD brought me here.
